scheme_name: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University
description:
The Merit cum Means Scholarship for Engineering University students is a significant initiative by the Government of India aimed at providing financial assistance to deserving students pursuing engineering courses. 

This scholarship scheme was launched in the year 2007. 

It is specifically designed to support students from economically weaker sections of society. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to enhance access to quality education in engineering institutions across India. 

The scholarship aims to reduce the financial burden on students and their families. 

It encourages meritorious students to pursue their dreams in engineering without the hindrance of financial constraints. 

The scholarship is available for students enrolled in undergraduate engineering programs. 

Eligible courses include Bachelor of Engineering and Bachelor of Technology degrees. 

The scholarship covers various engineering disciplines such as Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Electrical Engineering. 

The scheme is applicable to students studying in recognized engineering colleges and universities across India. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

Eligible students can receive up to INR 50,000 per annum. 

This amount is intended to cover tuition fees and other educational expenses. 

The scholarship is awarded based on both merit and means. 

Students must have a minimum percentage of 50% in their qualifying examination. 

The qualifying examination typically refers to the Class 12 board exams or equivalent. 

In addition to academic performance, the scheme has specific income criteria. 

The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed INR 2.5 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach those who are genuinely in need. 

The scholarship is available for students from all states and union territories in India. 

There are no restrictions based on caste or religion for eligibility. 

To apply for the Merit cum Means Scholarship, students must follow a specific application process. 

The application is typically submitted online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 

Students must create an account on the NSP to start their application. 

The required documents include a copy of the admission letter from the engineering college. 

Students must also provide proof of family income. 

This can be in the form of an income certificate issued by a competent authority. 

Additionally, students need to submit their Class 12 mark sheet. 

A passport-sized photograph is also required. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes a verification process. 

The verification is conducted by the respective state government or the institution. 

Students are advised to keep track of their application status on the NSP. 

The scholarship is disbursed annually. 

The disbursement typically occurs at the beginning of the academic year. 

Students can expect to receive the scholarship amount directly credited to their bank accounts. 

The scholarship is renewable for the duration of the engineering course. 

However, students must maintain a minimum academic performance to continue receiving the scholarship. 

This usually means securing at least 50% marks in each academic year. 

The implementing authority for this scholarship scheme is the Ministry of Education, Government of India. 

The National Scholarship Portal serves as the primary platform for application and disbursement. 

Students can contact the NSP helpline for any queries related to the application process. 

The helpline number is 1800 11 2001. 

The email support can be reached at helpdesk.nsp@gov.in. 

The scholarship has seen a significant uptake since its inception. 

In the year 2020 alone, over 1 lakh students benefited from this scheme. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the scholarship in the financial year 2022-2023. 

This reflects the commitment of the government to support higher education. 

The scheme also aims to bridge the gap in engineering education accessibility. 

It provides a much-needed financial cushion for students from lower-income backgrounds. 

The scholarship not only alleviates financial stress but also motivates students to excel academically. 

The impact of the scholarship can be seen in the increased enrollment of students from diverse backgrounds in engineering colleges. 

The government continuously reviews and updates the scheme to enhance its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The Merit cum Means Scholarship is part of a broader initiative to promote technical education in India. 

It aligns with the National Policy on Education which emphasizes equitable access to education. 

This scholarship scheme is a vital tool in achieving the goal of inclusive education. 

It plays a crucial role in empowering students and fostering a skilled workforce in the engineering sector. 

Overall, the Merit cum Means Scholarship for Engineering University students is a commendable effort by the Indian government. 

It not only supports students financially but also encourages them to pursue their aspirations in engineering. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's commitment to education and social equity. 

Through this initiative, many students have been able to transform their lives and contribute positively to society. 

The scholarship continues to evolve and adapt to the changing educational landscape in India. 

It remains a beacon of hope for many aspiring engineers across the nation. 

The success of the scheme is a testament to the importance of government support in education. 

It highlights the need for ongoing investment in human capital development. 

The Merit cum Means Scholarship is indeed a significant step towards a more educated and skilled India.
